motions.headline: Sweetwater tax increment routed to the agency
motions.summary: The agency board signed an agreement with the city setting how property taxes from the Sweetwater Industrial Park reinvestment area are collected and passed to the agency.
motions.impact: Money already collected in that industrial area moves between two sets of books. Nobody pays a new amount, and nothing on the ground changes because of this vote.

motions.headline: Tax deal approved with QTS Eagle Mountain I
motions.summary: The agency board approved a participation agreement with QTS Eagle Mountain I, LLC, for a project inside one of the city's community reinvestment areas.
motions.impact: No terms or dollar figures were read into the record, so this vote alone does not show what the company gets. The deal binds the agency and that company, not city services or your tax bill.
